en.t: Sima Zhao's regicide of Cao Mao
en.s: Sima Zhao's regicide of Cao Mao, also known as the Ganlu Incident (Chinese: 甘露之變), occurred on 2 June 260 in Luoyang, the capital of the state of Cao Wei, during the Three Kingdoms period. Cao Mao, the nominal emperor of Wei, attempted to oust the regent Sima Zhao, who effectively controlled the Wei government. However, the plot concluded with Cao Mao's death and Sima Zhao retaining his status.
en.n: Sima Zhao's regicide of Cao Mao, also known as the Ganlu Incident (Chinese: 甘露之變), occurred on 2 June 260 in Luoyang, the capital of the state of Cao Wei, during the Three Kingdoms period.

zh.s: 司马昭弑杀曹髦又称甘露之变，于260年6月2日在曹魏都城洛阳发生，当时正值三国时期。魏国名义上的皇帝曹髦试图除掉实际掌控魏国朝政的权臣司马昭，但计划最终以曹髦被杀告终，司马昭继续掌权。
zh.n: 司马昭弑杀曹髦又称甘露之变，于260年6月2日在三国时期曹魏都城洛阳发生。

en.s: The sack of Rome in 455 was carried out by the Vandals led by their king Gaiseric. A 442 treaty between the Western Roman Empire and Vandal Kingdom included a marriage of state between the daughter of Roman Emperor Valentinian III and the son of Gaiseric. Valentinian's successor Petronius Maximus violated the treaty by marrying his son to Valentinian's daughter, and Gaiseric retaliated with an invasion of Italy.

zh.s: 455年，盖萨里克率领汪达尔人洗劫罗马。442年，西罗马帝国与汪达尔王国缔结条约，其中包括罗马皇帝瓦伦提尼安三世之女与盖萨里克之子的政治联姻。瓦伦提尼安的继任者佩特罗尼乌斯·马克西穆斯让自己的儿子娶了瓦伦提尼安之女，违反条约；盖萨里克随即入侵意大利。

en.t: Pope Benedict I is consecrated after obtaining imperial approval from Constantinople
en.s: Pope Benedict I (Latin: Benedictus I; died 30 July 579) was the bishop of Rome from 2 June 575 to his death on 30 July 579. His pontificate took place during the Lombard expansion in Italy and during famine in Rome and other parts of Byzantine Italy.

zh.t: 教宗本笃一世祝圣就任
zh.s: 教宗本笃一世（拉丁语：Benedictus I；卒于579年7月30日）于575年6月2日至579年7月30日担任罗马主教。他任内正值伦巴第人扩张，以及罗马和拜占庭统治下的意大利其他地区遭遇饥荒。

en.s: The Hammadid capture of Béja in 1015 was an important military encounter between the Hammadid dynasty led by Hammad ibn Buluggin and the Zirid dynasty, led by Hashim, the best general of Badis ibn Al-Mansur. This occurred during the Hammadid–Zirid War, which ultimately resulted in the independence of the Hammadid emirate, thus splitting the previous Zirid domains into two independent emirates.

zh.t: 哈马迪王朝攻占贝贾（1015年）
zh.s: 1015年，哈马德·伊本·布卢金率领的哈马迪王朝与巴迪斯·伊本·曼苏尔麾下大将哈希姆率领的齐里王朝军队，在贝贾交战。这场战斗发生在哈马迪—齐里战争期间；战争最终使哈马迪埃米尔国独立，原齐里王朝领地分裂为两个独立的埃米尔国。

en.s: The siege of Antioch took place during the First Crusade in 1097 and 1098, on the Crusaders' way to Jerusalem through Syria. Two sieges took place in succession. The Crusaders sieged the city held by the Seljuk Empire from 20 October 1097 to 3 June 1098, when the Crusaders successfully took the city. A Seljuk relieving army then sieged the Crusaders for three weeks in late June.
en.n: First Crusade: The first Siege of Antioch ends as Crusader forces take the city; the second siege began five days later.

zh.s: 第一次十字军东征期间，1097年至1098年，十字军经叙利亚前往耶路撒冷，安条克围城战由此发生。围城战先后进行了两次。十字军于1097年10月20日至1098年6月3日围攻塞尔柱帝国控制的城市，最终成功攻占。6月下旬，塞尔柱援军随后围困十字军三周。
zh.n: 第一次十字军东征：十字军攻占安条克，第一次围城战结束；五天后第二次围城战开始。

en.s: The battle of Kurikara Pass (倶利伽羅峠の戦い, Kurikara tōge no tatakai), also known as the battle of Tonamiyama (砺波山), was a crucial engagement in Japan's Genpei War; in this battle the tide of the war turned in the favour of the Minamoto clan. "Yoshinaka won by a clever strategy; under cover of nightfall his troops enveloped the main body of the Taira, demoralized them by a series of tactical surprises, and turned their confusion into a disastrous, headlong rout."

zh.s: 1183年6月2日，源氏与平氏在日本越中国的俱利伽罗山口交战。源义仲率军包围平氏主力，趁夜发动突袭，平氏部队溃败。这场胜利扭转了源平合战的战局。

en.s: The Battle of Bogucin took place on the 2nd of June 1273 near Bogucin, not far away from Olkusz. It was part of the Civil war in Poland (1273–1274), fought between the Kingdom of Poland led by Bolesław V the Chaste against the Lesser Poland rebels led by Vladislaus I of Opole. It resulted in a Bolesław–loyal victory.

zh.s: 博古钦战役于1273年6月2日在博古钦附近发生，距离奥尔库什不远。这是1273—1274年波兰内战的一部分。交战双方是博莱斯瓦夫五世统治的波兰王国与弗瓦迪斯瓦夫一世·奥波莱率领的小波兰叛军。效忠博莱斯瓦夫的军队获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Batih (Ukrainian: Битва під Батогом, Polish: Bitwa pod Batohem; 1–2 June 1652) was fought between the Cossack Hetmanate and Crimean Khanate against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth as a part of the Khmelnytskyi Uprising.

en.s: The naval Battle of Palermo took place on 2 June 1676 during the Franco-Dutch War, between a French force sent to support a revolt in the city of Messina against the Spanish rule in Sicily, and a Spanish force supported by a Dutch maritime expedition force. The Dutch and Spanish ships were at bay making repairs from an earlier Battle of Augusta where Dutch Lt. Admiral General de Ruyter suffered lethal injuries. His death caused a severe impact on morale of the Dutch. The command of their fleet was transferred to Vice Admiral den Haen while the general command was assumed by Spanish Admiral de Ibarra.

zh.s: 1676年6月2日，法荷战争期间，法国舰队与西班牙—荷兰联军舰队在巴勒莫附近交战。法国舰队前往支援西西里墨西拿反抗西班牙统治的起义；西班牙舰队得到荷兰远征舰队支援。此前，荷兰和西班牙舰只正在海湾内维修，荷兰海军中将米希尔·德·鲁伊特在奥古斯塔海战中受了致命伤。他去世后，荷兰军队士气大受打击。荷兰舰队改由丹·海恩中将指挥，联军总指挥则由西班牙海军上将德·伊巴拉担任。

en.t: Bridget Bishop is the first person to be tried for witchcraft in Salem, Massachusetts; she is found guilty the same day and hanged on June 10
en.s: Bridget Bishop (née Magnus; c. 1632 – 10 June 1692) was a midwife and the first person executed for witchcraft during the Salem witch trials in 1692. Nineteen were hanged, and one, Giles Corey, was pressed to death. Altogether, about 200 people were tried.

zh.t: 布里奇特·毕晓普成为首位在马萨诸塞州塞勒姆受审的女巫，当天被判有罪，6月10日遭绞刑
zh.s: 布里奇特·毕晓普（娘家姓马格努斯；约1632年—1692年6月10日）是助产士，也是1692年塞勒姆女巫审判中首位被处决的人。共有19人被绞死，吉尔斯·科里则被压死。总计约有200人受审。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in Virginia on June 2, 1780. The incumbent governor of Virginia Thomas Jefferson was re-elected. The Senate and the House of Delegates met separately on June 1 to nominate candidates for governor; more than one nomination was made, requiring a vote of the Virginia General Assembly.

zh.s: 弗吉尼亚州于1780年6月2日举行州长选举，时任州长托马斯·杰斐逊成功连任。参议院和众议院于6月1日分别开会提名州长候选人。由于提名不止一人，弗吉尼亚州议会必须投票选举。

en.s: The French invaded the British-held island of Tobago in 1781 during the Anglo-French War. On 24 May 1781, the fleet of Comte de Grasse landed troops on the island under the command of General Marquis de Bouillé. By 2 June 1781, they had successfully gained control of the island.

en.s: The Action of 2 June 1803 was a military engagement between the US Navy and the Tripolitans during the First Barbary War. The Americans launched a raid to burn Tripolitan vessels carrying wheat. The raid ended in failure, and the wheat cargo was saved.

zh.s: 1803年6月2日海战是美国海军与的黎波里军队在第一次巴巴里战争期间发生的一次军事交战。美军发动袭击，试图烧毁装载小麦的的黎波里船只，但行动失败，小麦货物得以保全。

en.s: The Battle of Diamond Rock (French: Bataille du rocher du Diamant, Spanish: Batalla de la roca del Diamante) took place between 31 May and 2 June 1805 during the War of the Third Coalition, when a Franco-Spanish force dispatched under Captain Julien Cosmao was able to retake Diamond Rock, on the approach to Fort-de-France, from the British forces that had occupied it over a year before.

zh.s: 第三次反法同盟战争期间，法国和西班牙部队于1805年5月31日至6月2日发动行动，由朱利安·科斯毛上校率领，重新夺回马提尼克法兰西堡附近的钻石岩。该岩礁此前已被英国军队占领一年多。

en.t: 1808 United States Senate election in Massachusetts
en.s: The 1808 United States Senate election in Massachusetts was held on June 2, 1808. This unusually early election was called after Federalist incumbent John Quincy Adams broke with his party over the Embargo Act of 1807. The legislature elected state senator James Lloyd to the term beginning in March 1809.

zh.t: 1808年马萨诸塞州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 马萨诸塞州于1808年6月2日举行联邦参议员选举。此次选举异常提前，起因是联邦党籍时任参议员约翰·昆西·亚当斯因《1807年禁运法案》与本党决裂。州议会选举时任州参议员詹姆斯·劳埃德担任联邦参议员，任期于1809年3月开始。

en.t: 1817 Speaker of the British House of Commons election
en.s: The 1817 election of the Speaker of the House of Commons occurred on 2 June 1817. The incumbent Speaker Charles Abbot had resigned due to ill health. Charles Manners-Sutton was proposed by Sir John Nicholl and seconded by E. J. Littleton. Charles Williams-Wynn was proposed by William Dickinson and seconded by Sir Matthew White Ridley. Both candidates addressed the House. A debate followed.

zh.s: 英国下议院于1817年6月2日举行议长选举。时任议长查尔斯·阿博特因健康不佳辞职。约翰·尼科尔爵士提名查尔斯·曼纳斯-萨顿，E·J·利特尔顿附议。威廉·迪金森提名查尔斯·威廉斯-温，马修·怀特·里德利爵士附议。两位候选人都向下议院发表讲话，随后议员展开辩论。

en.s: The Battle of Ichkeria (1842) was an attempt by General Grabbe to take Imam Shamil's capital at Dargo during the Murid War. It mainly failed due to the difficulty of moving a large force through the forest. After his defeat at Akhulgo in 1839, Shamil established a new headquarters at Dargo in a forested valley in Chechnya about 33 kilometres (21 mi) south of the Russian lines.

en.t: The Slavic Congress opens in Prague
en.s: The Prague Slavic Congress of 1848 (Czech: Slovanský sjezd, Slovak: Slovanský zjazd/kongres) took place in Prague, Austrian Empire (now Czech Republic) between 2 June and 12 June 1848. It was the first occasion on which representatives from nearly all Slav populations of Europe met in one place to discuss the emerging idea of Pan-Slavism.

zh.t: 布拉格斯拉夫大会开幕
zh.s: 1848年布拉格斯拉夫大会于1848年6月2日至12日在奥地利帝国布拉格举行。来自欧洲几乎所有斯拉夫民族的代表首次齐聚一堂，讨论新兴的泛斯拉夫主义理念。大会的捷克语名称为Slovanský sjezd，斯洛伐克语为Slovanský zjazd或Slovanský kongres。

en.s: The Battle of Black Jack took place on June 2, 1856, when antislavery forces, led by the noted abolitionist John Brown, attacked the encampment of Henry C. Pate near Baldwin City, Kansas. The battle is cited as one incident of "Bleeding Kansas" and a contributing factor leading up to the American Civil War of 1861 to 1865.

zh.s: 黑杰克战役于1856年6月2日发生。约翰·布朗率领反奴隶制势力，袭击了堪萨斯州鲍德温市附近亨利·C·佩特的营地。这场战役被视为“流血堪萨斯”事件之一，也是促成美国内战（1861—1865年）的因素之一。

en.s: The 1862 Oregon gubernatorial election took place on June 2, 1862 to elect the governor of the U.S. state of Oregon. The election matched Republican Addison Crandall Gibbs against Democrat John F. Miller. Gibbs defeated Miller in a landslide.

zh.s: 俄勒冈州于1862年6月2日举行州长选举。共和党候选人艾迪生·克兰德尔·吉布斯与民主党候选人约翰·F·米勒角逐州长。吉布斯以压倒性优势击败米勒。

en.t: 1862–63 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1862–63 United States House of Representatives elections were held between June 2, 1862, and November 3, 1863, to elect the 184 members and eight non-voting delegates of the House of Representatives. The Republican–Union coalition lost seats but retained an overall majority against the backdrop of the American Civil War.

zh.s: 美国众议院选举于1862年6月2日至1863年11月3日举行，选出184名众议员和8名无投票权代表。共和党—联邦党联盟失去一些席位，但在美国内战背景下仍保住多数。

en.s: The Battle of Ridgeway (sometimes the Battle of Lime Ridge or Limestone Ridge) was fought in the vicinity of the town of Fort Erie across the Niagara River from Buffalo, New York, near the village of Ridgeway, Canada West, currently Ontario, Canada, on June 2, 1866, between Canadian troops and an irregular army of Irish-American invaders, the Fenians. It was the largest engagement of the Fenian Raids, the first modern industrial-era battle to be fought by Canadians and the first to be fought only by Canadian troops and led exclusively by Canadian officers.

zh.s: 里奇韦战役有时也称利姆里奇战役或石灰岩岭战役，于1866年6月2日在加拿大西部里奇韦村附近发生，地点靠近伊利堡镇，隔尼亚加拉河与纽约州布法罗相望。交战双方是加拿大军队和由爱尔兰裔美国人组成的芬尼亚人入侵军。这是芬尼亚袭击中规模最大的一场交战，也是加拿大现代工业时代的第一场战役，还是首场仅由加拿大军队参战、完全由加拿大军官指挥的战斗。

en.t: Nebraska holds its first state gubernatorial election before statehood
en.s: The 1866 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on June 2, 1866, before Nebraska officially became a state. The state constitution specified that the first election for governor should be held on that date in preparation for statehood. Republican nominee David Butler defeated Democratic nominee J. Sterling Morton.
en.n: The election took place before Nebraska became a state.

zh.t: 内布拉斯加在正式建州前举行州长选举
zh.s: 1866年6月2日，内布拉斯加在正式成为美国一个州之前举行州长选举。这次选举是为建州做准备，投票日期由当年的州宪法规定。共和党候选人大卫·巴特勒击败民主党候选人J.斯特林·莫顿。
zh.n: 此次选举举行时，内布拉斯加尚未正式成为美国的一个州。

en.s: The Nobiling assassination attempt, or the assassination attempt on Wilhelm I of 2 June 1878, was an armed attack carried out by Karl Nobiling, a German anarchist philosopher, against the Kaiser Wilhelm I, severely wounding him. Along with the Hödel assassination attempt, less than a month earlier and aimed at the same target, it was one of the first acts of propaganda by the deed in history.

zh.t: 诺比林刺杀威廉一世未遂
zh.s: 诺比林刺杀事件又称1878年6月2日对威廉一世的刺杀未遂。德国无政府主义哲学家卡尔·诺比林持枪袭击德皇威廉一世，致其重伤。这是历史上最早的“以行动宣传”事件之一。同一袭击目标在不到一个月前曾遭赫德尔刺杀未遂。

en.s: The Battle of Budla-an (Filipino: Labanan sa Budla-an, Cebuano: Sangka sa Budla-an, Spanish: Batalla de Budla-an) was fought on June 2, 1898, between the Philippine Cebuano rebel forces and Spanish and loyalist forces. en.s: The 1902 Oregon gubernatorial election took place on June 2, 1902, matching Republican W. J. Furnish against Democrat George Earle Chamberlain. The Republican nominating convention had been held on April 2. After incumbent governor Theodore Thurston Geer and C. A. Johns of Baker City withdrew, Pendleton mayor Furnish defeated H. E. Ankeny of Jackson County on the first convention ballot to win the nomination.
en.n: June 2 was the gubernatorial election; the Republican nomination was decided on April 2.

zh.t: 俄勒冈州举行1902年州长选举

zh.n: 6月2日是州长选举投票日，共和党提名已于4月2日决定。

en.s: The Battle of Boryspil happened on June 2, 1920, near the town of Boryspil near Kiev. It was fought between the Polish and Russian forces during the Polish-Bolshevik War and was a part of the Polish counter-assault after the ill-fated Russian offensive of May 27. After capturing Kiev in early May, the Polish and Ukrainian forces of 2nd and 3rd Armies were centered on Kiev, along the Dnieper river and a small bridgehead on the eastern side of the river. After the assault of the Budyonny's Cavalry Army has been repelled, the Polish commander Edward Rydz-Śmigły feared that the Russian forces of the 12th Army might want to assault the bridgehead directly.

zh.s: 博里斯皮尔战役于1920年6月2日在基辅附近的博里斯皮尔镇发生，是波苏战争期间波兰军队与俄军之间的一场战斗，也是波兰军队反攻的一部分。此前，俄军于5月27日发动进攻，但未能成功。5月初攻占基辅后，波兰和乌克兰第2、第3集团军部署在基辅及第聂伯河沿岸，并在河东岸守住一处小型桥头堡。布琼尼骑兵集团军的攻势被击退后，波兰指挥官爱德华·雷兹-希米格维担心俄军第12集团军会直接进攻桥头堡。

en.s: The Carrowkennedy Ambush was an ambush carried out by the Irish Republican Army (IRA) on Thursday 2 June 1921, during the Irish War of Independence. It took place at Carrowkennedy, near Westport, County Mayo. The ambush was organized by Major General Michael Kilroy, later Commandant of the 4th Western Battalion of the IRA. He and his flying column of volunteers took up position between Widow Sammon’s House and that of Widow McGreal in Carrowkennedy and awaited a Royal Irish Constabulary patrol.

zh.s: 爱尔兰共和军于1921年6月2日星期四发动卡罗肯尼迪伏击战，地点在爱尔兰独立战争期间的卡罗肯尼迪，靠近梅奥郡韦斯特波特。伏击由迈克尔·基尔罗伊少将组织，他后来担任共和军第4西部营指挥官。他率领一支机动纵队，在卡罗肯尼迪的萨蒙寡妇和麦格里尔寡妇两家住宅之间埋伏，等待皇家爱尔兰警察队巡逻队经过。

en.s: The 1924 Newfoundland general election was held on 2 June 1924 to elect members of the 26th General Assembly of Newfoundland in the Dominion of Newfoundland. The Liberal-Progressives and Liberal-Conservative Progressives were new parties formed as a result of the collapse of the ruling Liberal Reform Party. The Liberal-Conservative Progressives were led by Walter Stanley Monroe and won the election weeks after the party's creation.

zh.s: 纽芬兰于1924年6月2日举行大选，选出纽芬兰自治领第26届大议会议员。执政的自由改革党瓦解后，自由进步党和自由保守进步党作为新政党成立。自由保守进步党由沃尔特·斯坦利·门罗领导，在该党成立数周后赢得选举。

en.s: The Indian Citizenship Act of 1924 (43 Stat. 253, enacted June 2, 1924) was an act of the United States Congress that declared Native Americans born within the United States are US citizens. Although the Fourteenth Amendment to the U.S. Constitution provides that any person born in the United States is a citizen, there is an exception for persons not "subject to the jurisdiction" of the federal government.

en.s: The 1925 Saskatchewan general election was held on June 2, 1925, to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of Saskatchewan. The Liberal Party of Saskatchewan – under its new leader, Charles A. Dunning – won its sixth consecutive victory, and continued to dominate the legislature. The Progressive Party of Saskatchewan increased its share of the vote from 7.5% to over 23%, but failed to add to its six member caucus.

en.s: General elections were held in Romania in June 1939. The Chamber of Deputies was elected on 1 June, and the Senate on the following day. They were the first elections since the introduction of the royal dictatorship of King Carol II under the 1938 constitution. Voters were presented with a single list from the National Renaissance Front, which had been the only legally permitted party in Romania since December.

It was Panathinaikos' first ever Greek Cup final in their 32 years of existence and Aris' third Greek Cup final in their 26-year history.

zh.s: 1940年希腊杯决赛是该赛事第四届决赛，于1940年6月2日在亚历山德拉斯大道球场举行。对阵双方是帕纳辛奈科斯和阿里斯。这是帕纳辛奈科斯成立32年来首次进入希腊杯决赛，也是阿里斯成立26年来第三次闯入决赛。

en.s: The Massacre of Kondomari (Greek: Σφαγή στο Κοντομαρί) was the execution of male civilians from the village of Kondomari in Crete by an ad hoc firing squad consisting of German paratroopers on 2 June 1941 during World War II. The shooting was the first of a series of reprisals in Crete, orchestrated by Generaloberst Kurt Student, in retaliation for the participation of Cretans in the Battle of Crete which had ended with the surrender of the island two days earlier.

zh.s: 1941年6月2日，德国伞兵组成的临时行刑队在克里特岛孔多马里村处决当地男性平民。此次屠杀发生在第二次世界大战期间，是克里特岛一系列报复行动中的第一起，由库尔特·施图登上将策划，以报复克里特居民参与克里特岛战役。该战役于两天前随着岛屿投降而结束。

zh.s: 墨西拿船队海战于1943年6月1日至2日夜间在卡拉布里亚海岸、斯巴蒂文托角附近发生。交战一方是盟军第14驱逐舰支队的英国驱逐舰“杰维斯”号和希腊驱逐舰“瓦西莉萨·奥尔加”号；另一方是意大利货船“弗拉尼兹扎”号和“波斯图米亚”号组成的船队，由意大利鱼雷艇“卡斯托雷”号护航。

en.s: The 1945 Football League War Cup final was the last final of the Football League War Cup, a cup competition held in England during the Second World War as a replacement for the suspended FA Cup. The match was a play-off between the winners of the North and South competitions, respectively Bolton Wanderers and Chelsea. The match took place on 2 June 1945, and was staged at Stamford Bridge, Chelsea's home ground.

zh.t: 1945年英格兰足球联赛战争杯决赛
zh.s: 1945年英格兰足球联赛战争杯决赛是该项赛事的最后一场决赛。这项杯赛在第二次世界大战期间于英格兰举办，作为暂停举行的足总杯的替代赛事。决赛由北部和南部赛区冠军博尔顿流浪者与切尔西争夺，于1945年6月2日在切尔西主场斯坦福桥球场举行。

en.s: A constitutional referendum was held in Italy on 2 June 1946, a key event of Italian contemporary history. Until 1946, Italy was a kingdom ruled by the House of Savoy, kings of Italy since the Risorgimento and previously rulers of Savoy. However, Benito Mussolini, enjoying the support of the reigning monarch, imposed fascism after the 28 October 1922 March on Rome, eventually engaging Italy in World War II alongside Nazi Germany. In 1946, Italy became a republic after the results of a popular referendum. Monarchists had suspicions of fraud, but were never allowed to prove these.

zh.s: 意大利于1946年6月2日举行宪法公投，是意大利近代史上的重要事件。1946年以前，意大利是由萨伏依王朝统治的王国，该王朝自意大利统一运动以来一直担任意大利国王，此前则统治萨伏依。墨索里尼得到在位君主支持，于1922年10月28日进军罗马后建立法西斯统治，最终使意大利与纳粹德国并肩参加第二次世界大战。1946年，公投结果使意大利成为共和国。君主制支持者怀疑选举舞弊，但从未获准举证。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in France on 2 June 1946 to elect the second post-war Constituent Assembly designated to prepare a new constitution. The ballot system used was proportional representation. After the liberation of France in the Second World War, three parties dominated the political scene due to their participation in the Resistance to the German occupation: the French Communist Party (PCF), the French Section of the Workers' International (SFIO, socialist party) and the Popular Republican Movement (MRP) Christian democratic party.

zh.s: 法国于1946年6月2日举行立法选举，选出第二届战后制宪议会，负责起草新宪法。选举采用比例代表制。第二次世界大战结束、法国解放后，由于曾参与抵抗德国占领，三个政党主导政坛：法国共产党、工人国际法国支部（社会主义政党）和人民共和运动（基督教民主党）。

en.s: The Yangtze River Crossing campaign (Chinese: 渡江战役) was a military campaign launched by the People's Liberation Army to cross the Yangtze River and capture Nanjing, the capital of the Nationalist government of the Kuomintang, in the final stage of the Chinese Civil War. The campaign began at night on 20 April, and lasted until 2 June 1949, concluding after the fall of Nanjing and Shanghai to the Communist forces, which eventually resulted in the exile of the Nationalists to the island of Taiwan.

en.s: The 1997 Canadian federal election was held on June 2, 1997, to elect members to the House of Commons of the 36th Parliament of Canada. en.s: South Africa's second non-racial general election, was held on 2 June 1999. This election was won by the African National Congress (ANC), who increased their number of seats by 14. Incumbent president Nelson Mandela declined to be re-elected again as president. Notable was the sharp decline of the New National Party, previously the National Party (NP), which without former president F.W. de Klerk lost more than half of their support. The liberal Democratic Party became the largest opposition party, after being the 5th largest party in the 1994 election.

zh.s: 南非于1999年6月2日举行第二次不分种族的全国大选。非洲人国民大会获胜，增加了14个席位。时任总统纳尔逊·曼德拉拒绝再次连任。此前称为国民党的新国民党支持率大幅下滑，失去前总统F·W·德克勒克后，支持者减少了一半以上。自由派民主党取代它，成为最大反对党；该党在1994年选举中曾是第五大党。

en.s: The Siege of Lamitan took place on 2 June 2001 when members of the Islamist militant group Abu Sayyaf entered the city of Lamitan, one of two Christian settlements in the predominantly Muslim province of Basilan in the Philippines. They took over a church and a hospital and held priests, medical staff and patients hostage. Government forces surrounded the Muslim extremists, preventing their escape. However, the Abu Sayyaf group managed to break out of the cordon by using their hostages as human shields.

en.s: On 2 June 2010, 52-year-old taxi driver Derrick Bird carried out a spree shooting across multiple parts of Cumbria, England, killed twelve people and injured eleven others. The shootings ended when Bird killed himself in a wooded area after abandoning his car in the village of Boot.

en.s: Indirect presidential elections were held in Latvia on 2 June 2011. Incumbent president Valdis Zatlers was standing again, as well as Andris Bērziņš (Saeima member for the Union of Greens and Farmers), a former head of SEB Unibanka (not to be confused with Andris Bērziņš, former PM from Latvia's First Party/Latvian Way); Bērziņš was nominated by five Saeima members of the Union of Greens and Farmers just two days before the nomination deadline, although the party was assumed to back Zatlers for reelection.

en.t: Chikarasaurus Rex: How to Hatch a Dinosaur
en.s: Chikarasaurus Rex: How to Hatch a Dinosaur was a professional wrestling internet pay-per-view (iPPV) event produced by the Chikara promotion, that took place on June 2, 2012 at the Trocadero Theatre in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania and aired live on GoFightLive, with a pre-show airing live on Ustream. en.s: Slammiversary XI was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA) promotion, which took place on June 2, 2013 at the Agganis Arena in Boston, Massachusetts. It was the 11th anniversary celebration for TNA, and the ninth PPV under the Slammiversary chronology. Slammiversary XI was also the third event in TNA's 2013 pay per view schedule, following TNA Genesis 2013, TNA Lockdown 2013. Nine matches were featured on the card. The main event consisted of Bully Ray defeating Sting to retain the TNA World Heavyweight Championship in a No Holds Barred match with the stipulation that if Sting lost, he could no longer compete for the world title.

zh.s: 《Slammiversary XI》是全面不间断动作摔角联盟（TNA）主办的一场按次付费摔角赛事，于2013年6月2日在马萨诸塞州波士顿的阿甘尼斯竞技馆举行，庆祝TNA成立11周年，是该系列第九届赛事，也是TNA 2013年按次付费赛程中的第三场赛事，此前已举行《创世记》和《封锁》。本届赛事共安排九场比赛。主赛为无规则赛，布利·雷击败斯汀，保住TNA世界重量级冠军头衔。根据赛前约定，如果斯汀落败，他将不能再挑战世界冠军。

en.s: Aniversario: Never Compromise was a professional wrestling internet pay-per-view (iPPV) event produced by the Chikara promotion, that took place on June 2, 2013, at the Trocadero Theatre in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The event marked Chikara's fourth iPPV, third to take place at the Trocadero Theatre and the promotion's only event to take place in Philadelphia in 2013. en.t: Telangana officially becomes the 29th state of India, formed from ten districts of northwestern Andhra Pradesh
en.s: Telangana is a state in southern India on the Deccan Plateau bordering Maharashtra and Chhattisgarh to the north and Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka to the south. It is the eleventh largest and the twelfth most populated state of India. According to the Rigveda's Aitareya Brahmana, the region corresponding to Telangana has been inhabited by the Asmakas and Andhras since at least the 8th and 9th century BCE, respectively, with the later Satavahana dynasty, who ruled over the entire Deccan Plateau, establishing trade relations as far as the Roman Empire.

Zenit Saint Petersburg won the match 2–1 for their sixth Russian Cup, earning their first ever domestic treble, previously having won the 2023 Russian Super Cup and the 2023–24 Russian Premier League.

zh.s: 2024年俄罗斯杯决赛因赛事采用新赛制而正式称为“超级决赛”，是第32届俄罗斯杯决赛，也是2023—24赛季的最后一场比赛。比赛于2024年6月2日在俄罗斯莫斯科卢日尼基体育场举行，由加里宁格勒波罗的海和圣彼得堡泽尼特对阵。泽尼特以2比1获胜，赢得队史第六座俄罗斯杯，并首次实现国内三冠王；此前已赢得2023年俄罗斯超级杯和2023—24赛季俄罗斯超级联赛冠军。

en.t: 2026 California Superintendent of Public Instruction election
en.s: The 2026 California Superintendent of Public Instruction election began on June 2, 2026 and will conclude on November 3, 2026, to elect the next Superintendent of Public Instruction of California. Unlike most other elections in the state, the office is not elected under the state's top-two primary system. Instead, the officially nonpartisan position is elected at a primary election, with a runoff at a general election if no candidate receives a majority of the vote.

en.t: 2026 Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors election
en.s: The 2026 Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors election took place on June 2, 2026, in Los Angeles County, California. Two of the five seats on the board were up for election in four-year terms. Municipal elections in California are officially nonpartisan; candidates' party affiliations do not appear on the ballot. Incumbent supervisor Lindsey Horvath won re-election and María Elena Durazo also won in an outright, negating the need for a runoff.
